definitions.gloss: regional revitalization; local revitalization; regional renewal
definitions.explanation: Government policy and efforts aimed at revitalizing rural and regional areas of Japan facing population decline and economic stagnation.

examples.japanese: {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Regional revitalization has become an important national issue.

examples.japanese: {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移住|いじゅう}→移住：13752_ijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促進|そくしん}している→促進する：19632_sokushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: To revitalize the regions, they are promoting migration of young people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}した→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧{地方創生|ちほうそうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Efforts at regional revitalization through tourism are spreading across the country.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (region, locality) + {創生|そうせい} (creation, genesis). A key policy term in Japan since 2014 when the government established the {まち・ひと・しごと創生本部|そうせいほんぶ} (Headquarters for Overcoming Population Decline and Vitalizing Local Economy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧: regional revitalization policy
- {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work on regional revitalization
- {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}{交付金|こうふきん}: regional revitalization grant

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's regional areas face ⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧ (depopulation) as young people move to ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧ and other major cities. {地方創生|ちほうそうせい} aims to reverse this trend through job creation, tourism development, and incentives for relocation to rural areas.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{過疎|かそ}→過疎：14756_kaso⟧: depopulation (of rural areas)
- {町興|まちおこ}し: town revitalization — a grassroots, community-level effort
- {地域活性化|ちいきかっせいか}: regional activation — similar concept, more general term
